name: Subaru Yamato
source:
Akizuki High School, 3rd year student. Vice Captain of the Superpower club whose known for having a bad mouth
He usually acts cool and rational but deep inside is a passionate hotbloodedness that only Azuma can surpass.
He has the superpower "Accelerate" which he can use to speed up his own movements for a short time.
